offer: DCWP-licensed & insured. Free photo estimate, work from $150.

guides.title: Interior Painting Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does Interior Painting Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC interior painting prices by room, apartment and ceiling — labor ranges, what's extra.
guides.lead: Scuffed walls, patched holes, or a color you stopped liking three years ago. Here is what a room, a hallway or a whole apartment actually costs to paint in New York City — the same numbers our calculator quotes.
intro: Painting is priced by the surface, not the hour: how many walls, how tall the ceiling, how much prep the walls need before the first coat, and whether furniture has to be moved and covered. Every figure below is labor — we prep, prime and roll two coats of low-VOC paint with furniture covered; paint and materials are quoted separately or supplied by you.
Prices are pulled from the same catalog the estimate calculator on the painting page uses, so what you read here is what you would see there.
drivers: Wall condition: patched holes, cracks and old glossy paint all add prep before the first coat.
Ceiling height: pre-war 10–12 ft rooms mean ladders, cut-in time and more paint.
Color change: dark-to-light or light-to-dark needs an extra coat or a tinted primer.
Trim, doors and closets: quoted as their own line, not folded into the wall price.
Access: walk-up floors, elevator reservations and COI paperwork for co-ops and condos.
included: Surface prep: filling nail holes, light sanding, spot priming
Two coats of low-VOC paint on the agreed surfaces
Furniture moved to the center and covered, floors protected
Clean-up and a walk-through before we leave
extra: Paint, primer and materials (supplied by you or quoted separately)
Skim coating and wallpaper removal; heavy patching is included only in the tiers that say so
Ceilings and trim when not in the agreed scope — they have their own tables above
notOurJob: Full lead-paint abatement in pre-1978 buildings is a licensed abatement contractor's job — we flag it from photos rather than paint over it.
faq: How long does it take to paint a room in NYC?
A standard bedroom with two coats is usually one visit; a full apartment runs over several days depending on prep and how many rooms can be cleared at once.
Do I need to buy the paint?
You can supply it, or we quote paint and primer separately after you pick colors. Labor prices above do not include materials.
Do you paint ceilings and trim?
Yes — ceilings, trim, doors and baseboards are quoted as their own lines, which is why they have separate tables above.
Can you fix holes and cracks before painting?
Nail holes and light cracks are part of prep. Larger drywall damage is a separate drywall repair, quoted from photos before painting starts.

guides.title: Floor Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Laminate & Vinyl
guides.h1: How Much Does Floor Installation Cost in NYC? Laminate, Vinyl Plank and Peel-and-Stick (2026)
guides.description: NYC floor installation prices for laminate, vinyl plank, click-lock and peel-and-stick.
guides.lead: Boxes of flooring already stacked in the room? Here is what installing laminate, vinyl plank, click-lock and peel-and-stick floors costs in New York City apartments, from a closet to a whole unit.
intro: Floor installation is priced by area and by what is under the new floor. Laminate and click-lock installs depend on product thickness, locking profile, underlayment, expansion gaps and how level the existing floor is. Peel-and-stick is cheaper to lay but only as good as the subfloor it sticks to. The tables below are labor for laying the product you supply; underlayment, transitions and subfloor prep are quoted separately.
These are the same ranges the calculator on each flooring page shows — one price list, not two.
drivers: Room size and shape: closets and hallways mean more cuts per square foot than an open room.
Subfloor condition: an uneven or damaged subfloor needs prep before any plank goes down.
Product: thick laminate with a tight locking profile lays slower than vinyl plank.
Doorways and thresholds: every transition is a clean cut and a matching strip.
Baseboards: removing and resetting them is part of the job when the room has them.
included: Subfloor check and moisture/level review before we start
Underlayment and planks laid with correct expansion gaps
Clean cuts around doorways, thresholds and built-ins
Baseboards set back and the room swept
extra: Flooring, underlayment, transitions and trim (client-supplied or quoted)
Old-floor removal, subfloor leveling, transitions and baseboard work — included only in the tiers that name them; on install-only tiers they are quoted separately
Furniture moving beyond what fits in the room
notOurJob: Floors over radiant heat, structural subfloor repair or anything that alters the building's slab is reviewed from photos first and may be outside handyman scope.
faq: Is laminate or vinyl plank cheaper to install in NYC?
Labor is similar; vinyl plank usually lays faster in small, cut-heavy rooms. The bigger cost difference is usually the product itself.
Do you remove the old floor?
Removal and haul-away are quoted separately once we see what is under the current floor — carpet, tile and glued vinyl are all different jobs.
Do I need underlayment?
Most laminate and click-lock products do; some vinyl planks have it attached. We confirm from the product's spec before the visit.
Can you level an uneven subfloor?
Minor leveling is quoted as subfloor prep. If photos show soft spots or structural issues we say so before booking.

guides.title: Faucet Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Kitchen & Bathroom
guides.h1: How Much Does Faucet Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC faucet and sink installation prices for kitchen, bathroom and shower faucets.
guides.lead: Dripping at the base, or a new faucet still boxed under the sink? Here is what replacing a kitchen, bathroom, widespread or shower faucet costs in New York City when the existing hookups are compatible.
intro: A faucet swap is one of the most predictable handyman jobs — when the sink, hole count, shut-offs and supply lines match the new faucet. That is why we review photos first: a corroded shut-off or a three-hole sink for a single-hole faucet changes the job. Prices below are labor; the faucet, supply lines and any adapter are yours or quoted separately.
The ranges are the same ones the faucet page calculator quotes.
drivers: Faucet type: single-hole, centerset, widespread and wall-mount all mount differently.
Shut-off valves: a valve that will not close has to be replaced before the faucet comes off.
Access: pedestal sinks and tight vanities take longer than an open kitchen base.
Sink swap: a new sink with the faucet is its own line — see the second table.
Building rules: COI paperwork and water shut-off notice in co-ops and condos.
included: Removing the old faucet and cleaning the deck
Connecting compatible supply lines and the new faucet
Leak test under pressure before we leave
Sprayer, soap dispenser or drain assembly when they come with the faucet
extra: The faucet, supply lines, adapters and drain assembly — the parts themselves
Shut-off valve replacement and new supply lines are included in the tiers that name them; on a straight swap they are quoted separately
Sink replacement, countertop cutting or cabinet modification — see the sink table
notOurJob: Anything that alters the piping behind the wall or under the floor is a Licensed Master Plumber's work — we identify the boundary from photos before scheduling.
faq: Can you replace a faucet if the shut-off valves are stuck?
Often yes, by replacing the valve as a separate line. If the building main has to be shut, we coordinate that with your super before the visit.
Do you install the faucet I bought?
Yes. Send the model link and a photo of the sink from above and below so we can confirm hole count and fit.
What if the sink needs to be replaced too?
Sink installation is its own line in the second table; drop-in and undermount are priced differently.
How long does a faucet swap take?
Most kitchen and bathroom swaps are done in a single visit.

guides.title: Toilet Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Swap & Replace
guides.h1: How Much Does Toilet Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC toilet replacement prices: standard, comfort-height, one-piece, wall-hung, smart.
guides.lead: Running, rocking, or leaking at the base? Most toilet swaps are done in one visit. Here is what a standard, comfort-height, one-piece, wall-hung or smart toilet costs to install in New York City.
intro: Toilet replacement is priced by the model and by what the floor looks like once the old toilet is off. Standard round, elongated, comfort-height, dual-flush and skirted models are all on the list; smart toilets and bidet seats need an existing outlet in reach, so a photo of the wall behind the bowl matters. Prices below are labor; the toilet, wax ring or seal, bolts and supply line are yours or quoted separately.
Same numbers as the toilet page calculator.
drivers: Model: skirted, one-piece and wall-hung toilets take longer to set and align than a standard two-piece.
Flange and floor: a cracked flange or soft floor has to be addressed before the new toilet is set.
Shut-off valve: a valve that does not close fully gets replaced first.
Old toilet disposal: haul-away is quoted separately and depends on building rules.
Smart toilets: need a grounded outlet within reach and sometimes a water filter line.
included: Removing the old toilet and cleaning the flange
Setting the new toilet with a fresh seal and bolts
Connecting the supply line and testing for leaks
Seat installation and flush test
extra: The toilet, seal, bolts and supply line — the parts themselves
Shut-off valve replacement and old-toilet haul-away are included in the tiers that name them; on a straight swap they are quoted separately
Bidet seat or smart toilet electrical accessories
notOurJob: If photos show a cracked flange, a soft floor, a hidden leak, a stack issue or anything that means altering pipe, we say so before booking and point you to a Licensed Master Plumber.
faq: Can you install a smart toilet or bidet seat?
Yes, when there is a grounded outlet in reach. Send a photo of the wall behind the bowl and the model link.
Do you take the old toilet away?
Haul-away is quoted separately; some buildings require the super to handle bulk disposal.
What photos speed up the quote?
The existing toilet, the shut-off valve, the floor around the base and a link to the new model.
Is a wall-hung toilet a handyman job?
Replacing one on an existing carrier is. Installing a new in-wall carrier alters the plumbing and is a Licensed Master Plumber's job.

guides.title: Ceiling Fan Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does Ceiling Fan Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC ceiling fan installation prices for swaps, hugger, downrod, remote and outdoor fans.
guides.lead: Fan wobbling, or a new one still boxed in the hallway? Here is what a fan swap, a hugger, a downrod fan or a fan with light and remote costs to install in New York City when the ceiling box is fan-rated.
intro: Every installation includes support and existing-box review, secure mounting, blade balancing, light kit assembly and a full speed and direction test. The price moves with the fan: a like-for-like swap on a fan-rated box is the base case; downrods, remote kits and outdoor fans add time. Prices are labor; the fan, remote kit and downrod are yours or quoted separately.
Same ranges as the ceiling fan page calculator.
drivers: Existing box: it must be fan-rated. If it is not, the support change is flagged before booking.
Ceiling height: downrod fans in tall rooms need ladder work and balancing.
Controls: remote kits, wall controls and light kits are each tested separately.
Fan size and weight: large or heavy fans take longer to hang and balance.
Location: outdoor and covered-balcony fans have wet-rated parts to check.
included: Existing box and support review
Mounting, wiring to the existing fan connection and balancing
Light kit and remote setup
Full speed and direction test
extra: The fan, downrod, remote or wall control
A fan-rated brace: the labor is in the mid tier that names it, the brace itself is a part
Patching or painting around the canopy
notOurJob: If the existing setup is not suitable, we flag the needed support or Licensed Master Electrician scope before booking — new circuits, new locations and wiring routes are permit-level work in NYC.
faq: Can you install a fan where there is only a light?
When the box is fan-rated and the wiring already serves that location, yes. Otherwise the box or brace change is flagged first.
Do you set up the remote?
Yes — remote kits, wall controls and light kits are set up and tested as part of the install.
My fan wobbles. Is that a repair or a replacement?
Usually a balancing and mount check, quoted from a short video. If the box is the problem, that is flagged before any work.
How long does a fan swap take?
A like-for-like swap on a fan-rated box is typically done in one visit.

guides.title: Light Fixture Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Chandeliers Too
guides.h1: How Much Does Light Fixture or Chandelier Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC light fixture and chandelier installation prices: flush, pendant, sconce, track.
guides.lead: Fixture you ordered still sitting in the hallway? Here is what replacing a flush mount, pendant, sconce, track light or chandelier costs in New York City when the existing box and wiring fit the product.
intro: Every replacement request includes fixture weight review, box and mounting checks, dimmer compatibility review, ladder access review and a function test. The price follows the fixture: a flush mount on an existing box is the base case; pendants with long drops, multi-light track and heavy chandeliers take more time and sometimes more support. Prices are labor; the fixture, bulbs and dimmer are yours or quoted separately.
Same ranges as the light fixture and chandelier page calculators.
drivers: Fixture weight: heavy fixtures may require additional support before hanging.
Ceiling height: double-height and stairwell fixtures need taller ladders or scaffolding.
Canopy size: a new canopy that does not cover the old opening means patching.
Dimmers: LED fixtures and old dimmers do not always agree — we check compatibility.
Assembly: crystal and multi-arm chandeliers can take longer to assemble than to hang.
included: Taking down the old fixture and checking the box
Hanging and wiring the new fixture to the existing connection
Dimmer compatibility review
Function test before we leave
extra: The fixture, bulbs and dimmer
Additional support or a new box for heavy fixtures
Patching and painting around a smaller canopy
notOurJob: New fixture locations may require a new box, electrical routing, a NYC Licensed Master Electrician and a DOB permit. We replace fixtures where they are; we do not add locations.
faq: Can you hang a heavy chandelier?
Yes, after a weight and support review from photos. Heavy fixtures may need additional support, which is quoted first.
Can you move a light to a new spot on the ceiling?
No — a new location means new wiring, which is Licensed Master Electrician and DOB permit territory in NYC.
Do you install dimmers?
Replacing a compatible switch with a dimmer is a switch installation, quoted as its own line.
What should I send for a quote?
The fixture link or weight, ceiling height, a photo of the current fixture and any ladder or building access limits.

guides.title: Dishwasher Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does Dishwasher Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC dishwasher installation prices for swaps, first-time installs and built-in panels.
guides.lead: New dishwasher sitting in the box? Here is what a swap, a first-time install into an existing opening, or a panel-ready built-in costs in New York City when the supply, drain and outlet or hardwire are compatible.
intro: A dishwasher install is placement and leveling, secure mounting, connection to compatible existing supply, drain and outlet or hardwire, then a leak and cycle test. A like-for-like swap is the base case. First-time installs into an existing cabinet opening and panel-ready built-ins take longer. Prices are labor; hoses, adapters and the cord kit are quoted separately if the box does not include them.
Same ranges as the dishwasher page calculator.
drivers: Swap vs first install: an opening that has never had a dishwasher needs the drain and supply reviewed before the unit goes in.
Hookup type: outlet vs hardwire, and whether the existing drain allows a proper high loop.
Panel-ready units: the cabinet panel alignment is its own step.
Access: tight kitchens, freight elevators and COI paperwork.
Old unit: haul-away is quoted separately.
included: Placement, leveling and secure mounting
Connection to compatible existing supply, drain and outlet or hardwire
Drain high loop
Leak and full cycle test
extra: Old-unit haul-away and a new supply line — included in the tiers that name them, otherwise quoted separately
Replacement hoses, adapters or cord kit
Cabinet or floor correction and first-time opening adjustments
Difficult access labor
notOurJob: New water lines, new circuits, hardwired changes and permit-level work may require a Licensed Master Plumber or Electrician — we identify that from photos before booking.
faq: Can you install a dishwasher where there has never been one?
Into an existing cabinet opening with a compatible supply, drain and outlet or hardwire, yes. If any of those is missing, that part is a licensed trade's job.
Do you take the old dishwasher?
Haul-away is quoted separately and depends on building disposal rules.
Do I need to buy hoses?
Many units ship without a supply line or cord kit. Send the model number and we tell you what to have on hand.
How long does it take?
A straightforward swap is usually one visit, including the test cycle.

guides.title: Washer & Dryer Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does Washer and Dryer Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC washer and dryer installation prices: stacked, side-by-side, all-in-one units.
guides.lead: Washer and dryer going into a tight apartment closet? Here is what stacked, side-by-side, all-in-one and laundry-center installs cost in New York City when the water, drain, vent and power already fit the units.
intro: Every installation is reviewed around water supply connection, drain hookup, dryer venting or ventless setup, leveling, stacking kit compatibility, access and a full test cycle. Stacked sets in closets are the classic NYC job — and the one where the stacking kit and vent routing decide the price. Prices are labor; stacking hardware, hoses, cords and vent parts are quoted separately.
Same ranges as the laundry page calculators.
drivers: Configuration: stacked sets need the kit fitted and the units aligned in a closet-width space.
Venting: a routed dryer vent vs a ventless condenser unit.
Second technician: heavy units up walk-up stairs or into tight closets.
Drain and valves: a floor drain vs standpipe, and valves that actually close.
Gas dryers: reviewed before booking and only on existing code-ready connections.
included: Water supply and drain connection to the existing hookups
Dryer vent routing or ventless setup on the existing layout
Stacking kit installation and leveling
Full test cycle
extra: Stacking hardware, new hoses, cords, vent parts and drain pans — the parts themselves
Old-unit haul-away — included in the tiers that name it, otherwise quoted separately
Tight-access labor and a second technician
notOurJob: Plumbing, gas, electrical or permit corrections require the proper licensed trade. Gas connections are reviewed case by case and are not sold as handyman work.
faq: Can you install a ventless washer-dryer combo?
Yes — all-in-one and ventless units are on the list; the drain and power connection are reviewed from photos first.
Do I need a stacking kit?
Most stacked sets do, and it is model-specific. Send both model numbers and we confirm the right kit.
Can you hook up a gas dryer?
Only on an existing, code-ready gas connection after review. New or altered gas piping is a Licensed Master Plumber's job.
What if the units do not fit the closet?
Send closet width, depth and door measurements with the model numbers before delivery — we check clearance before you order.

guides.title: Drywall Repair Cost NYC 2026 | Holes, Cracks, Water Damage
guides.h1: How Much Does Drywall Repair Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC drywall repair prices for small holes, large patches, cracks, water damage, texture.
guides.lead: Doorknob hole in the hallway, or a crack that keeps coming back? Here is what patching small holes, large holes, cracks, water damage and texture blending costs in New York City, paint-ready.
intro: Drywall is priced by the size and type of damage: a handful of nail holes, a doorknob hole, a large patch that needs new board, a recurring crack, water-damaged board or a texture blend. We patch, tape, sand and prime it paint-ready, blending texture where we can. Prices are labor and standard patching materials; painting is its own line.
Same ranges as the drywall page calculator.
drivers: Hole size: anything larger than a fist needs a backed patch or new board.
Cracks: a crack that returns is usually movement; the fix is taping and skimming, not filling.
Water damage: the board has to be dry and the source fixed before repair.
Texture: orange peel, knockdown and smooth can usually be blended closely, but the final match depends on the existing texture, paint age and lighting.
Plaster walls: pre-war plaster repairs are quoted from photos, not by the same rules as drywall.
included: Patch, tape and compound
Sanding and priming so the area is paint-ready
Texture blending where the existing finish allows
extra: Painting the repaired wall — included only where a tier says so (with your paint); otherwise quoted as a painting line
Replacing large sections of board
Fixing the leak or moisture source behind water damage
notOurJob: Water damage with an active leak is a plumbing problem first — we repair the wall after the source is fixed.
faq: Will the patch be invisible?
Smooth walls blend very well after paint. Textured walls come close; the final match depends on texture, paint age and lighting.
Do you paint the patch?
Priming is included; painting is quoted as a painting line so the whole wall matches.
Can you repair plaster walls?
Yes, quoted from photos — pre-war plaster behaves differently from drywall.
How many holes count as small?
Nail and screw holes are grouped; a doorknob-size hole is its own line in the table.

guides.title: Lock Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Deadbolt, Smart, Mortise
guides.h1: How Much Does Lock Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC lock installation prices for deadbolts, levers, smart locks, mortise and strikes.
guides.lead: Not sure who still has a key? Here is what installing a deadbolt, a knob or lever set, a smart lock, a mortise lock or a new strike plate costs in New York City apartments and brownstones.
intro: Before anything is drilled we check door thickness, bore size, backset, latch depth, existing holes, strike alignment and the condition of the frame. Doors in walk-ups and pre-war buildings settle and get patched, so the existing holes rarely line up with a modern lock body without adjustment — that adjustment is where the price moves. Prices are labor; the lock hardware is yours or quoted separately.
Same ranges as the lock page calculator.
drivers: Lock type: a deadbolt into an existing bore is the base case; mortise bodies and smart locks take longer.
Door condition: patched or misaligned holes need chiseling or a wrap plate.
Smart locks: clearance, door thickness and WiFi or hub requirements are checked first.
Frame and strike: a strike that does not line up means the door will not lock without a shove — fixed as part of the job.
Metal doors: common in NYC buildings and slower to drill than wood.
included: Door, bore and frame check before drilling
Lock body, latch and strike plate installation
Alignment so the door locks without force
Smart lock pairing when the app and hub are ready
extra: The lock hardware and batteries
Wrap plates, filler plates or door repair for badly damaged bores
Rekeying — that is a locksmith's service
notOurJob: If you are locked out right now, lost your only key, or need an existing cylinder rekeyed without new hardware, call a locksmith — that is their work, not ours.
faq: Can you install a smart lock on my apartment door?
Usually, after checking door thickness, clearance and whether the building allows it. Send a photo of the door edge and the current lock.
Do you rekey locks?
No — rekeying and lockouts are locksmith work. We install new hardware.
My door does not lock without slamming. Is that a lock job?
Often it is strike alignment or a settled frame; both are part of a lock installation or a door repair.
Can you install a lock on a metal door?
Yes; metal doors are common in NYC buildings and are quoted from photos of the door edge.

guides.title: Mirror, Shelf & Art Mounting Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does It Cost to Hang a Mirror, Shelf or Art in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC mirror, floating shelf and art mounting prices on drywall, plaster and tile.
guides.lead: Heavy mirror still leaning against the wall since delivery day? Here is what anchoring mirrors, floating and bracket shelves, and framed art costs in New York City on drywall, plaster and tile.
intro: Mounting is priced by weight, wall type and how many pieces. A framed mirror on drywall with a stud behind it is the base case; oversized frameless mirrors, heavy floating shelves and gallery walls take longer and need the right anchors for the wall. NYC walls are the variable: plaster over lath, tile, concrete and metal studs each need a different anchor. Prices are labor and standard anchors; specialty hardware is quoted separately.
Same ranges as the mirror, shelf and art page calculators.
drivers: Wall type: drywall, plaster, tile or concrete decides the anchor and the time.
Weight and size: oversized mirrors and heavy shelves need studs or rated anchors.
Quantity: gallery walls and multi-shelf runs are priced per set, level and spaced.
Bathroom mirrors: tile and vanity lights around the mounting area slow things down.
included: Stud finding and the right anchors for the wall
Level, plumb mounting at the agreed height
Cleats, brackets or French cleats supplied with the item installed
Clean-up of drilling dust
extra: Specialty anchors for concrete or hollow tile
Patching old holes from previous hardware
Assembly of shelving units — see furniture assembly
faq: Can you hang a heavy mirror on plaster walls?
Yes — plaster over lath is common in pre-war buildings and just needs the right anchors and a stud where the weight demands it.
Do you hang mirrors on tile?
Yes, with tile-rated bits and anchors. Send a photo so we can see grout lines and the tile type.
Do you bring anchors and screws?
Standard anchors are included; specialty hardware for concrete or hollow tile is quoted separately.
Is a gallery wall priced per picture?
Priced as a set based on the count and layout you send.

guides.title: Wallpaper Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Price Guide
guides.h1: How Much Does Wallpaper Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC wallpaper installation and removal prices: peel-and-stick, vinyl, grasscloth, mural.
guides.lead: Rolls sitting in the hallway and nobody to hang them? Here is what hanging peel-and-stick, pre-pasted, vinyl, grasscloth and mural wallpaper costs in New York City — and what removal costs when the old paper has to come down first.
intro: Wallpaper is priced by the wall area and by the paper: peel-and-stick is the fastest, pre-pasted and vinyl need soaking or paste, grasscloth and murals need careful pattern matching and cannot be re-positioned. We prep the wall, match the pattern and cut clean around outlets and corners. Any visit has a $150 work minimum, and paper, primer and paste are not included.
Same ranges as the wallpaper page calculators.
drivers: Paper type: grasscloth and murals are the slowest to hang and the least forgiving.
Pattern repeat: large repeats mean more waste and more matching time.
Wall prep: existing paper, glossy paint or rough walls need priming or a liner.
Room complexity: windows, outlets and corners per wall drive the time more than square footage.
Removal: old paper and adhesive residue are their own line — see the second table.
included: Wall prep and priming on the agreed walls
Pattern matching and seam alignment
Clean cuts around outlets, corners and trim
extra: Paper, primer, paste and liner
Removal of existing wallpaper
Drywall or plaster repair under the old paper
faq: Do you supply the wallpaper?
No — you choose and order it; we tell you how many rolls to buy from the wall measurements and pattern repeat.
Can you hang peel-and-stick over painted walls?
Yes on smooth, clean, cured paint. Textured or glossy walls need priming first.
Do you remove old wallpaper?
Yes, quoted from the second table. The wall condition under the old paper decides whether a skim coat is needed before the new paper.
How much extra paper should I order?
Plan for the pattern repeat plus one extra roll; we confirm the count when we see the wall measurements.

guides.title: Door Installation Cost NYC 2026 | Prehung, Slab & Barn
guides.h1: How Much Does Door Installation Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC door installation prices: slab, prehung, closet, barn, pocket and storm doors.
guides.lead: New door leaning against the hallway wall, still in its wrap? Here is what hanging a slab in an existing frame, setting a prehung door, or installing a closet, barn, pocket or storm door costs in New York City — labor for the door you supply.
intro: A door is priced by how much fitting it needs, not by the door itself: the table runs from a same-size slab on the old hinges, to a slab trimmed, mortised and bored to fit, to a prehung door that replaces the jamb. Prices are labor; the door, jamb, casing and hardware are yours to supply.
Same ranges as the door installation page calculator.
drivers: Slab vs prehung: a slab is fitted to the frame you already have; a prehung door comes in its own jamb, so the old jamb comes out and the new one is set plumb in the rough opening.
Out-of-square frames: pre-war openings settle and lean, so a slab is scribed to the old frame or a prehung jamb is shimmed further. An oversized or out-of-square storm-door opening is its own tier.
Floor clearance: new flooring, a threshold or a thick rug can mean trimming the bottom of the slab.
What the hardware bolts into: a barn door track goes into studs, or onto a header board first over plaster or masonry; pocket doors are priced on an existing pocket frame.
Quantity: on the slab, prehung, closet and pocket lines, two or three doors in one visit are one tier, so label each door and opening before the visit.
Building rules: co-op and condo COI requirements, permitted work hours and a service-elevator booking for the door delivery decide when the job can be scheduled.
included: Measuring the opening and checking the frame, swing direction and floor clearance
Hanging the door, with hinges mortised and the latch and strike fitted
Trimming, boring and new casing in the tiers that name them
A swing and latch test so the door closes without scraping or springing open
extra: The door, jamb, casing, hinges and lockset — the parts themselves
Painting, staining and finish trim
Repairs to a loose or rotted jamb, or correcting an uneven floor — flagged with the adjustment needed before booking
notOurJob: Cutting a new opening, removing or re-framing studs, and anything at DOB permit level goes to a licensed contractor. A pocket-door frame kit is stud framing too, so your contractor builds the frame and we hang the slab and fit the track and hardware once it is in.
faq: Is a prehung door more expensive to install than a slab?

Usually, yes. A slab reuses the frame you already have, so the work is fitting the door to it: trimming, mortising the hinges and boring for the lockset. A prehung door arrives in its own jamb, so the old jamb comes out, the new one is shimmed plumb and level in the opening and the casing is reset. When the existing frame is sound and square, a slab is the cheaper route; when the frame is damaged or badly out of square, prehung is usually the better one.
My door frame is out of square. Will a new door fit?

Usually — few pre-war NYC frames are perfectly square. A slab can be scribed and planed to the frame's actual shape, and a prehung jamb is shimmed until it hangs plumb. Send a photo of the closed door showing the gaps along the top and sides, and the width and height measured at both ends of the opening; that shows which route costs less. A loose or rotted jamb, or a floor that slopes, is flagged with the adjustment needed before we book.
How does a co-op or condo building change a door installation?

Mostly through paperwork and timing. Many buildings ask for a Certificate of Insurance naming the management company, allow work only on weekdays within set hours, and want the service elevator reserved for the door delivery. Repair ASAP LLC provides the COI at no additional cost; send the building's rules with your photos so the visit is booked inside them. The apartment entry door onto the public hallway is typically fire-rated, with building and code limits, so replacing it needs management sign-off before you order anything; lock changes on it are covered in the lock installation guide.
Can you hang a barn door on a plaster or brick wall?

Yes. The track carries the whole weight of the door, so it has to bolt into studs. On pre-war plaster or masonry, where the studs are not where the track needs them, a header board is fixed to the wall first and the track mounts to it — that is the middle barn-door tier in the table. Double doors or an oversized, heavy slab are the top tier.
Do you install pocket doors?

On an existing pocket frame, yes: re-hanging the slab, or replacing the track, rollers and hardware. Building a new pocket into the wall is stud framing, so the frame kit goes to your contractor, and we hang the slab and fit the track and hardware once the frame is in.
Can you replace an exterior entry door or add a storm door on a house?

Yes. In our Staten Island entry door case study, the old storm door, the door and the worn frame came out, a new prehung exterior door was set plumb, level and square, the unused second lock bore was capped and the perimeter was sealed with low-expansion spray foam, in about three and a half hours; a new storm door with an automatic closer then took about four hours, most of it lock and closer prep. An exterior entry door is quoted from photos of both sides of the opening. For storm doors, a direct swap into an existing storm-door frame is the first storm line in the table, and a new storm door that has to be drilled, shimmed and sealed with a closer is the next.
What should I send for a door installation quote?

Photos of the opening and the existing door from both sides, the width and height of the opening, the swing direction, the door type or a product link, a photo of the hinges and latch, and your building's COI or work-hour rules. If you are replacing several doors, label each door and opening — sizes that look identical often are not.

guides.title: Caulking Cost NYC 2026 | Tub, Shower & Window Sealing
guides.h1: How Much Does Caulking and Sealing Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC caulking prices: tub and shower re-caulking, sinks, backsplash, window drafts.
guides.lead: Black line along the tub that no longer scrubs out, or a draft around the window frame every winter? Here is what stripping and re-sealing a tub or shower, a sink or backsplash, or sealing windows and doors against drafts costs in New York City.
intro: Caulking is priced by where the joint is, how much of it there is, and whether the old bead has to come out first; stripping moldy or built-up caulk is where the time goes. Standard sealant is included in these prices, chosen per joint: mold-resistant silicone for wet areas, paintable acrylic for trim, polyurethane where the joint moves.
Same ranges as the caulking page calculator.
drivers: Old caulk: a new bead on a clean joint is the base case; stripping old, moldy or layered caulk and scraping the residue out adds most of the time.

Wet or dry joint: tubs, showers, sinks and backsplashes get mold-resistant silicone on a fully dry joint and need about 24 hours before use; trim and baseboard gaps take paintable acrylic and are priced by the room.
How much joint: one tub or one sink edge is the small tier; two bathrooms, a full kitchen perimeter or a whole apartment of windows is the large one.
Windows and doors: draft sealing is priced by the number of openings — one or two windows, three to five windows or doors, or six and more.
What is behind the joint: loose tile, soft drywall or an active leak is flagged before sealing, because caulk would only hide it.
included: Stripping loose, moldy or failed caulk in the tiers that include it
Cleaning and drying the joint before sealing
Standard sealant chosen per joint — mold-resistant silicone, paintable acrylic or polyurethane
A smooth, even bead, with messy old buildup removed where practical
extra: Painting over new paintable caulk on trim and baseboards — a painting line
Window problems caulk cannot fix: worn weatherstripping, broken balances or a sash that no longer closes are a window repair
Anything found behind a failed joint — loose tile, soft drywall or a leak — is flagged before sealing, not priced as caulking
notOurJob: Mold in or behind the wall, or mold that keeps coming back after a proper re-caulk, is remediation work for a licensed contractor, not a caulk job.
Facade, roof and above-grade exterior joints are outside handyman scope.
faq: Is re-caulking a tub or shower priced differently from sealing windows?

Yes, because the work is different. A tub or shower is a wet joint: the old bead is stripped, mold and soap residue are cleaned out, the joint is dried and re-sealed with mold-resistant silicone, and the tub or shower should stay unused for about 24 hours while it cures. Window and door sealing is priced by the number of openings rather than by the fixture: the gaps around the frame and trim are sealed against drafts, without a wet-area cure wait. Each has its own line in the table.
Will caulking stop the winter drafts around my windows?

It stops drafts that come through the gaps where the window frame and trim meet the wall, which are easy to find on a windy day by holding a damp hand or a strip of tissue along the trim. One or two windows are the small tier; three to five openings, or a whole-apartment draft seal, are the larger ones. Air coming through a worn sash, failed weatherstripping or a window that no longer closes tight is a window repair, not a caulk job.
Why does black mold keep coming back in my shower caulk?

Usually because new caulk went over old caulk, or onto a joint that was still damp, so the mold underneath keeps growing and shows through. Surface mold on the old bead comes out with the bead when it is stripped properly, and the joint is dried before mold-resistant silicone goes on. If it returns within weeks, or the wall behind feels soft, the moisture is coming from somewhere else — that is flagged for the right trade instead of sealed over.
How long before I can use the shower after re-caulking?
Plan on about 24 hours. Silicone only bonds to a clean, dry joint and needs that time to cure, so if it is the only shower in the apartment, plan the visit around it.
Do you seal the outside of windows and doors?

The draft-sealing line in the table is priced by the number of windows and doors, and its first tier is the interior perimeter of one or two windows. Facade, roof and exterior joints above ground level are outside handyman scope. For an exterior joint at ground level, such as around a house entry door, send photos: whether it is in scope, and at what price, is confirmed in your quote.
What should I send for a caulking quote?

Close photos of each joint, the room, the rough length, whether the old caulk is still there, any mold or soft spots, and whether the area is fully dry or still leaking. For drafts, say how many windows and doors there are and at which ones you feel the air.

guides.title: Cabinet Painting Cost NYC 2026 | Kitchen & Vanity Prices
guides.h1: How Much Does Cabinet Painting Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC cabinet painting prices for kitchens, vanities, islands, built-ins and furniture.
guides.lead: Cabinet boxes still solid, but the finish yellowed, chipped or dated? Here is what painting kitchen cabinets costs in New York City, priced by the count of doors and drawer fronts, and what a vanity, an island, built-ins or a single furniture piece costs on its own.
intro: Kitchens are the first three rows of the table; the lowest figures in the guide belong to a single vanity or one small furniture piece, not a kitchen. Every tier includes removing and labeling the doors and hardware, degreasing, sanding, a bonding primer, two coats of cabinet-grade paint and reinstallation with the hinges adjusted. Paint, primer and new hardware are extra unless you ask us to supply them.
Same ranges as the cabinet painting page calculator.
drivers: Doors and drawer fronts: the count sets the tier — up to 15 fronts for a galley kitchen, 16–30, or 31 and more for a large kitchen.
Boxes and frames: say whether the face frames and exposed box sides should be painted with the doors; that, and any interiors or shelves, is confirmed in the quote from your photos.
Grease and old finish: degreasing and a bonding primer are in every tier, but glossy factory finishes, laminate and dark-to-light color changes may need extra prep or primer.
Sprayed or brushed: spraying gives the smoothest finish where the space can be masked and ventilated and the building allows it; otherwise the paint is brushed and rolled.
Condition: peeling veneer, swollen MDF, water damage or failing hinges are flagged before paint.
Pre-1978 buildings: suspected lead paint on original millwork or old painted doors is flagged before any sanding.
included: Doors, drawer fronts and hardware removed and labeled
Degreasing and sanding
Bonding primer and two coats of cabinet-grade paint
Reinstallation with hinges adjusted
extra: Paint, primer and new hardware, unless you ask us to supply them
Cabinet interiors and shelves, when you want them painted too
Filling old hardware holes and drilling new ones for different pulls — a cabinet hardware line
notOurJob: Peeling veneer, swollen MDF and water-damaged boxes are not fixed by paint — when refacing or replacement is the honest answer, we say so instead of painting over it.
In pre-1978 buildings we stop and flag suspected lead paint before sanding original millwork, built-ins or old painted doors; lead abatement is a licensed abatement contractor's job.
faq: Is cabinet painting priced per door?

By the count of doors and drawer fronts together — that is the axis the table and the calculator use. A galley kitchen with up to 15 fronts is the small tier, 16–30 the middle one, and 31 or more a large kitchen. Count every door and drawer front, including the small ones over the fridge and the range hood, and send that number with wide photos of each wall of cabinets.
Do you paint the cabinet boxes or only the doors?

The doors and drawer fronts set the tier. Whether the face frames and exposed box sides are painted along with them, so the kitchen reads as one finish, is confirmed in your quote. Cabinet interiors and shelves are not assumed; say which you want when you send photos.
Why does degreasing matter so much?

Kitchen cabinets, especially near the range, carry a film of cooking grease that paint will not bond to, and paint over grease is the most common reason painted cabinets chip and peel. Every tier includes degreasing, sanding and a bonding primer before the two coats. Glossy factory finishes, laminate and dark-to-light color changes may need extra prep or primer, which is called out before the work starts.
Sprayed or brushed: which finish will I get?

Spraying gives the smoothest finish and is used when it is possible: the area has to be masked and ventilated, and the building has to allow it. Where spraying is not practical, the doors and frames are brushed and rolled with the same cabinet-grade paint. Both get the same prep, primer and two coats; which one fits your kitchen is confirmed before the visit.
How long will my kitchen be out of use?

A full kitchen typically runs 3–5 days, because cabinet paint needs cure time before the doors go back on and get handled. The kitchen stays partly usable throughout: the work can be phased so some cabinets stay in service while doors and drawer fronts dry.
Can I change the cabinet hardware at the same time?

Yes. The hardware comes off anyway, so new knobs or pulls go on at reinstallation. If the new pulls need different hole spacing, filling the old holes and drilling new ones is priced as a cabinet hardware line — mention it with your photos so it is done before the paint goes on.

guides.title: Accent Wall Cost NYC 2026 | Painted Feature Wall Prices
guides.h1: How Much Does an Accent Wall Cost in NYC? (2026 Prices)
guides.description: NYC painted accent wall prices: solid, two-tone, stripes, geometric and deep colors.
guides.lead: Same beige wall behind the sofa for years? Here is what painting one feature wall costs in New York City — a solid color, a two-tone block, stripes, a geometric pattern or a deep color over a light wall.
intro: An accent wall is priced by the look and by the wall: a solid color on a standard wall (up to about 12 ft wide, 8–9 ft ceiling) is the base case, and stripes, geometric layouts, taller walls and heavier patching move it up the table. Paint, primer and tape are extra unless you ask us to supply them. This guide prices painted accent walls; wood slat, molding and acoustic panel walls are quoted from photos.
Same ranges as the accent wall page calculator.
drivers: Style: a solid color is the base case; two-tone blocks, stripes and geometric patterns are priced by how many tape lines and colors the layout needs.
Wall size and ceiling height: walls wider than about 12 ft and pre-war ceilings of 10 ft and up mean more paint, ladder work and cut-in.

Color change: the deep-color line already includes a tinted primer and two coats, so on a standard wall it starts at the same figure as a solid color; a large wall or a third coat for full coverage is its middle tier.

Wall condition: small holes are patched in every tier; on the solid-color line, minor patching is the middle tier and heavy patching or a skim coat the top one, while for a patterned wall, damaged or textured plaster is prepped and quoted separately.
What is on the wall: outlets, shelves, trim and out-of-square corners change how a pattern lands, so layouts are checked against a straight-on photo first.
More than one wall: two or three walls, solid or patterned, are priced as a set in the multiple-walls line.
included: Floor and trim protection
Small holes patched before paint
Taping and layout, checked against a straight-on photo of the wall
Primer where the color change needs it, two coats and clean edges
extra: Paint, primer and tape, unless you ask us to supply them
Wallpaper removal, or prep of a textured or damaged wall
faq: Why does a patterned accent wall cost more than a solid one?

Stripes, chevrons and geometric patterns cost more because the time goes into layout: measuring, marking level lines, taping every edge, painting each color and pulling the tape for a clean line. A solid wall is two coats and clean edges. The table prices each style on its own line, from a standard wall to a tall wall or a complex layout, so the difference for your wall size is visible before you decide.
Does a dark accent wall need extra coats?

Usually. Navy, forest green or black over a light wall gets a tinted primer and two coats, which the deep-color line already includes; a third coat, for colors that still look patchy, is its middle tier. A dark color also shows every flaw in the wall, so patching matters more than under a pale one.
My wall is pre-war plaster with cracks. Can it still be an accent wall?

Yes, after prep. Small holes are patched in every tier. On the solid-color line, minor patching is the middle tier, and cracked or uneven plaster that needs heavy patching or a skim coat is the top one; under a patterned design, damaged plaster is prepped and quoted separately. Send a close photo of the cracks and one taken with light raking across the wall from the side, which shows unevenness a straight-on photo hides.
Do you install wood slat or acoustic panel accent walls?

Those are installation jobs rather than painting, so they are not in this table. Slat, molding and acoustic panel walls are quoted from photos and wall measurements with the product you have chosen. The prices in this guide are for painted accent walls only.
How long does an accent wall take?

A single accent wall typically takes 3–5 hours, including prep, two coats and clean-up. Patterns with several colors, and deep colors that need a tinted primer, take longer because each coat has to dry before the next.
What should I send for an accent wall quote?

A straight-on photo of the wall, its approximate width and height, the color or pattern you have in mind, photos of any outlets, shelves, trim or damage on it, and the paint brand and color if you have chosen one.

faq: Do you assemble IKEA furniture in NYC?
Yes — IKEA is by far the most common furniture we assemble: PAX, KALLAX, MALM, HEMNES, BESTÅ, BILLY and NORDLI are all priced by series and size in the table above.
Is there a minimum for a furniture assembly visit?
Yes. Any visit has a $150 work minimum, which covers the first item; additional items in the same visit are priced individually, so bundling several pieces into one appointment is the best value.
Do you anchor bookshelves and wardrobes to the wall?
Wall anchoring where the manufacturer requires it — bookshelves, wardrobes and dressers — is part of the assembly price.
Do you take the cardboard away?
Cardboard disposal is available on request. We confirm it when booking, because some buildings have their own rules for bulk recycling.

legacy.description: TV mounting in NYC apartments: plaster, brick, concrete or drywall — rules, hardware, prices.
faq: Can you mount a TV on plaster walls?

Yes. Plaster looks solid but does not hold standard drywall anchors well, so for a 55-inch or larger TV we mount into studs — and plaster fools most stud finders, which is why we locate them ourselves.
Can you mount a TV on brick or concrete?
Yes, with masonry anchors rated for the TV and mount weight. Send a photo of the wall and the TV size for the exact quote.
Can you hide the cables?

Two options: a paintable surface raceway, which needs no drywall cutting and is the right choice for rentals, or in-wall cable management, which hides everything but requires cutting drywall — check your building's rules first.
Does my building need a Certificate of Insurance?
Many NYC co-ops and condos require proof of insurance before any contractor works. We provide a COI and can name the management company as additionally insured.
Should I mount the TV myself?

On modern drywall with wood studs and a TV under 50 inches, confident DIY-ers usually manage. For older buildings, plaster, brick, concrete or large TVs, professional mounting is worth it — a fallen TV can injure someone and void the warranty.
